body: West-facing, so the light is best from about 17:30. Bring something to sit on. Open all night, but unlit past the promenade section.
The grounds are open even when the church is not. Quietest mid-afternoon.
The perimeter walk is about 2 km. No shade at all until the sun drops.
Closed Mondays. The grounds photograph better than the interior.
Fills up after 19:00 on weekends. Two-seaters by the window go first.
Opens at 07:00, so this is the one that works before anything else does.
Nothing opens before 17:00. Busiest around 20:00, which is when it is best.
Closed Monday and Tuesday. The pottery session needs about two hours.
Shuts at 17:00 and the last order is earlier. Daytime only.
Evenings only, and the room is small. Worth checking they can seat you.
Friday to Sunday only. The house is part of the visit, so allow time to look.
Furthest out of the set. The trike is a special trip, so it is charged once.
Open until 20:00, but the animals are less active late. Go before sunset.
Bright and loud. Good for a gift stop rather than somewhere to linger.
